description.value:
Some fighters bring a blade to a fight; the Demolitions Specialist brings a bag full of charges. Trained in the art of controlled destruction, they treat every obstacle, bunker, or armored hull as a problem best solved with a well-placed explosive.

Beyond mere sappers, these warriors have learned to fight with their charges as extensions of their combat instincts, turning thrown explosives into a core part of how they engage the enemy. In their hands, an ordinary battlefield quickly becomes a minefield of their own design.
